## Failure mode

What false green, unsafe edge, or evidence gap does this change address?

## Executable evidence

- [ ] A test or fixture fails without the change.
- [ ] `node scripts/check.js` passes.
- [ ] `node --test` passes.
- [ ] Documentation and non-claims remain accurate.
- [ ] No runtime dependency was added, or the need is justified explicitly.

## Security boundary

Describe any effect on worktree isolation, command execution, symlinks, reports, credentials, or privileged workflow events.
